title: 8 Signs a Godly Man's "Brothers" Are Just Guys He Knows
caption:
Not every guy in your contacts is a brother.

A group chat that only reacts with emojis isn't accountability. A crew that only shows up when it's easy isn't brotherhood.

Proverbs 27:17 says iron sharpens iron. That takes contact, not proximity.

Check your list. Then call one of them today.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #brotherhood #community
